caption:
बॉक्स ऑफिस पर Rocking Star Yash ने रावण बनकर ऐसा गदर मचाया है कि सब देखते रह गए! 💥

नितेश तिवारी की फिल्म Ramayana: Part 1 से Yash ने हिंदी सिनेमा में इतिहास का सबसे बड़ा डेब्यू दर्ज कर लिया है। रणबीर कपूर और साई पल्लवी के साथ आई इस फिल्म ने BookMyShow पर टिकट बिक्री के सारे पुराने रिकॉर्ड ध्वस्त कर दिए हैं। रिलीज के दूसरे संडे दोपहर 3 बजे तक फिल्म के 12.71 million टिकट्स बिक चुके हैं।

इस शानदार आंकड़े के साथ फिल्म ने Chhaava, Jawan, Stree 2 और Animal जैसी बड़ी ब्लॉकबस्टर फिल्मों को पीछे छोड़ दिया है। अब इस लिस्ट में सिर्फ Dhurandhar और Dhurandhar 2 ही आगे हैं। फिल्म ने 9 अलग-अलग दिनों में 1 million से ज्यादा टिकट बेचने का रिकॉर्ड बनाया है, जिसमें Day 5 पर सबसे ज्यादा 1.66 million टिकट्स बिके थे। 🎟️

रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक फिल्म का नेट कलेक्शन 700 करोड़ पार हो चुका है और यह Dhurandhar के 14.19 million रिकॉर्ड को पीछे छोड़ने की तरफ तेजी से बढ़ रही है। 🚀

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana जल्द ही Dhurandhar का ऑल-टाइम रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana BMS Sales: Yash Marks Biggest Bollywood Debut, Axing Ticket Sales Of Every Single Bollywood Film Except 2!
ctx.summary:
Ranbir Kapoor & Yash's Ramayana has surpassed the ticket sales of every single Bollywood film except two - BMS sales report. 
 The post  Ramayana BMS Sales: Yash Marks Biggest Bollywood Debut, Axing Ticket Sales Of Every Single Bollywood Film Except 2!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Rocking Star Yash has announced his arrival in Hindi cinema with an earth-shattering ticketing milestone! Co-starring as Ravana in director Nitesh Tiwari’s mythological epic, Ramayana: Part 1, alongside Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi, Yash has officially registered the biggest Bollywood debut in BookMyShow history, dismantling the lifetime ticket sales of almost every Hindi film ever tracked on the platform!
Sustaining phenomenal audience footfalls into its second weekend, Ramayana has crossed a massive 12.71 million tickets sold on BookMyShow till day 11, second Sunday, 3 PM. With this phenomenal tally, the epic has bulldozed past modern giants like Chhaava, Jawan, and Stree 2. In fact, it has surpassed Animal, leaving only two Bollywood films ahead of it!
Powered by an extraordinary 1.66 million peak on Day 5 (Monday) and a massive comeback on Day 10 (Second Saturday) with 1.01 million tickets sold, Ramayana has delivered nine separate single-day figures exceeding the 1 million ticket mark on BMS!
Ever since BookMyShow introduced its public hourly and daily ticket-trending feature in August 2023, only ten Bollywood films have crossed the 7 million mark, and Ramayana has surged straight into the top 3 spots, standing only behind Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar 2!
Check out the top 10 BMS sales of Bollywood films since the trending feature was introduced in August 2023.
Making his Hindi film debut as Ravana opposite Ranbir Kapoor’s Lord Ram, Yash has bypassed every single Bollywood blockbuster barring the Dhurandhar franchise, giving him the highest-selling Hindi debut on BookMyShow by a landslide! Trailing Dhurandhar ( 14.19 million ) by just 1.48 million tickets, Ramayana is firmly on course to overtake it during Week 2 and claim the #2 spot in Bollywood BMS history!
